newsitem.title: GERMANY: VKR offers 415 dm/shr for Gelsenwasser minorities.
newsitem.headline: VKR offers 415 dm/shr for Gelsenwasser minorities.

text.p: Veba Kraftwerke Ruhr AG (VKR) said on Thursday that it had offered minority shareholders of Gelsenwasser AG 415 marks per share as part of a takeover bid.

Since February 18, the utility VKR, a unit of diversified utility giant Veba AG has held a 50.01 percent majority stake in fellow power group Gelsenwasser AG through its subsidiary WWB Wasserwerks-Beteiligungs GmbH, VKR said.
The group said that it held 43.5 percent of Gelsenwasser at the end of December 1995. German cartel authorities have agreed to the takeover of a majority stake.

The offer to minority shareholders is valid from March 1 through April 1 and the price is based on the bourse price of Gelsenwasser shares on February 26. The group said it was above the average price in the last six months of 410 marks.
